top_signals.title: RICO Lawsuit: Are Major Freight Brokers Manipulating the Market?
top_signals.summary:
A bombshell RICO lawsuit accuses major freight brokers C.H. Robinson and TQL of market manipulation through “forced labor.” FreightWaves expert John Kingston breaks down why these racketeering claims, traditionally used against organized crime, are hitting the logistics industry. We also explore the ongoing diesel price decline and Uber Freight’s CEO challenging Gartner’s Magic Quadrant methodology. […]
